name: GFV Platform
install: npm ci && npm ci --prefix functions && node functions/scripts/generate-tony-configs.js

terminals.name: app-server
terminals.description: Static PWA served by http-server on http://127.0.0.1:8000 (app entry: /core/dashboard-standalone.html). Root / is the public landing page.

terminals.name: firebase-emulators
terminals.description: Firebase Auth (9099) + Firestore (8080) emulators for local dev/testing. Requires Java (bundled in the base image). Seed data with `npm run sim:run -- --template=viticola-conto-terzi-manodopera`, then open /core/dev/simulator-dev-standalone.html?emulator=1 (password SimGFV2026!).
